what_it_is.prose: Godrej Aerospace is the aerospace business unit of Godrej & Boyce Mfg Co Ltd (founded 1897), part of the Godrej Enterprises Group. Long-standing partnership with ISRO spanning decades — manufactures Vikas liquid rocket engines (used in PSLV, GSLV, LVM3 second-stage L110). Delivered first-of-its-kind human-rated L110 Stage Vikas Engine to ISRO on 13 November 2025 — for use in the Gaganyaan human spaceflight programme's LVM3 launch vehicle. Also supplies cryogenic engine subsystems for GSLV/LVM3 upper stages. BrahMos airframe supplier — delivered landmark 100th airframe set to BrahMos Aerospace on 5 December 2017; first air-launched BrahMos airframe delivered 31 August 2018; produced 100+ land-based and sea-based BrahMos airframes before that. Building semi-cryogenic engines for ISRO.

faq.question: When did Godrej Aerospace deliver the first human-rated Vikas engine to ISRO?
faq.answer: 13 November 2025 — first-of-its-kind human-rated L110 Stage Vikas Engine for the Gaganyaan programme (LVM3 launch vehicle)

faq.question: When did Godrej deliver its 100th BrahMos airframe?
faq.answer: 5 December 2017 — landmark 100th set of airframe assemblies to BrahMos Aerospace Pvt Ltd; first air-launched BrahMos airframe delivered 31 August 2018

faq.question: Is Godrej Aerospace listed?
faq.answer: No — Godrej Aerospace is a division of Godrej & Boyce Mfg Co Ltd (private Godrej Enterprises Group); the broader Godrej group has listed entities (Godrej Industries Ltd, NSE: GODREJIND)
